unknowns.answer: The routes are POST v1beta/{model=models/*}:generateContent and :streamGenerateContent. SSE is selected with ?alt=sse, and the stream is a series of whole GenerateContentResponse objects (E-02). The x-goog-api-key header appears on countTokens (E-06) and on interactions (E-01, E-03), but E-02's examples only use key= in the query string, so whether the header works on :streamGenerateContent and how the stream ends are left to probe U-18 (4).

E-02 covers functionDeclarations (OpenAPI 3.0.3 subset or parametersJsonSchema), a functionCall with an optional id and object args and no partial-argument field, and a functionResponse matched by id. It contradicts itself on the role of a function response (user/model versus function). E-03 is the Interactions variant, so whether one turn can hold several calls is not stated for generateContent. Waiting for the generateContent function-calling page.

Part.thoughtSignature is an opaque field for reuse in later requests, and MISSING_THOUGHT_SIGNATURE is a finish reason (E-02). Signatures are required for continuity across turns (E-04). So the Gemini adapter must replay those parts unchanged through the wire-state store. Not stated: which parts carry a signature, whether a missing one returns 400, and how signatures travel on the compatible endpoint (E-07 is silent; probe U-18 (8)).

E-02 gives the full FinishReason list (STOP, MAX_TOKENS, SAFETY, RECITATION, MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL, MISSING_THOUGHT_SIGNATURE and others), the prompt-level promptFeedback.blockReason (with no candidates), and the usageMetadata fields (promptTokenCount, cachedContentTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount, thoughtsTokenCount, totalTokenCount). Which chunk carries usage, and whether its counts are cumulative, is probe U-18 (4).

E-05 says to retry 429/503/408/5xx with exponential backoff and never retry 400/402/403, but no captured page gives the over-window status or body; the troubleshooting page now points to the API errors page. E-06 shows countTokens taking a contents body and returning the input total; whether it accepts tools is not stated (probe U-18 (9)). Waiting for https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/api-errors.

E-07: base URL v1beta/openai/ with Bearer auth; tools and stream:true are shown; reasoning_effort maps to thinking levels; the layer is labelled beta. Not stated on E-07: max_completion_tokens, stream_options, the streamed tool-call shape, and how thought signatures travel; these go to probes U-18 (1) and (8).

E-08: POST /v1/messages with anthropic-version (example 2023-06-01) and content-type required. Authorization: Bearer is the primary auth; x-api-key is a legacy fallback. E-09: max_tokens is required. E-10: the event flow, ping and error events, and the deltas text_delta, input_json_delta (partial JSON), thinking_delta and signature_delta. Usage is on message_start and message_delta but absent in the thinking example; whether it is cumulative is probe U-18 (6).

E-09 gives tool definitions with input_schema, tool_use blocks (id, name, object input) and tool_result blocks with tool_use_id in the next user message. E-11 requires one tool_result per tool_use and nothing else in that message, and lists all seven stop reasons (refusal is an HTTP 200; model_context_window_exceeded counts as truncated; pause_turn applies to server tools only). E-09, E-12 and E-13 require thinking blocks to come back unmodified, or the request gets a 400. An is_error field is not stated.

E-13: an input alone over the window gets 400 invalid_request_error 'prompt is too long'. On Claude 4.5 and later, input plus max_tokens over the window is accepted and stops with model_context_window_exceeded. E-12: 413 request_too_large comes from Cloudflare over 32 MB, 529 is overloaded_error, and errors after a 200 arrive as SSE error events (E-10). The exact body bytes are probe U-18 (2).

E-15: the layer exists at api.anthropic.com/v1/. max_completion_tokens, stream, stream_options and tools are fully supported, unsupported fields are mostly ignored silently, prompt_tokens_details is always empty, and thinking is never returned. Since thinking is on by default on Claude 5 models (E-15, E-12), multi-turn tool use is probe U-18 (8). No statement about production use.

E-16 gives the status enum (completed/failed/in_progress/cancelled/queued/incomplete), incomplete_details reasons, usage with cached and reasoning tokens, function_call items with call_id and string arguments, and a deprecated truncation that 400s over-window by default. E-18 says max_output_tokens can end incomplete before any visible output. Neither E-16 nor E-17 gives the wire event names for incomplete or failed responses. Waiting for the responses-streaming reference.

E-18 'highly recommends' passing reasoning items back with function outputs, via previous_response_id or by replaying them. With store:false, items carry encrypted_content by default; the include value is legacy but accepted. Reasoning is reusable only within one model family. E-16 and E-18: max_output_tokens includes reasoning tokens. A store:false adapter therefore keeps the reasoning items in wire state.

E-19: thinking is on by default, and with tools, reasoning_content from all earlier turns must be sent back on every request (including new questions), or the API returns 400. So the existing kind breaks on DeepSeek's second tool request. E-20: the cap is max_tokens only (max_completion_tokens is not documented), usage comes on the last chunk, streamed tool calls carry index and id, and finish_reason adds insufficient_system_resource and aborted. E-20 disagrees with E-19 on request-side reasoning_content; E-19 is trusted. The rest is probe U-18 (7).

E-22: Bearer to api.mistral.ai/v1/chat/completions, max_tokens is the only documented cap, stream_options is absent from the schema, and the stream ends with data: [DONE]. The captured source HTML shows stream tool_calls with id and index, finish_reason values (stop, length, model_length, error, tool_calls), and a usage object. E-23: results go back as role tool with tool_call_id. The id format is not stated, and the examples differ (D681PevKs versus a UUID), so whether a minted id is accepted is probe U-18 (5).

E-24: max_tokens and max_completion_tokens are both accepted, and tools in OpenAI shape are transformed for other providers. E-26: usage is always in the last SSE message, and stream_options is deprecated and has no effect. E-25: ': OPENROUTER PROCESSING' comment lines must be skipped; a usage chunk repeats finish_reason; errors after commit arrive inside the 200 stream with finish_reason 'error' and must be treated as failure. What happens to an unsupported parameter is not stated.

Anthropic (E-14, E-12): a 429 carries retry-after in seconds plus anthropic-ratelimit headers; a spend-cap 429 has no retry-after and the code enforced_spend_limit_reached; 529 is transient. Gemini (E-05): 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and 503 are retried with exponential backoff and jitter (the SDK does about 1 s to 60 s, four retries), and 400/402/403 are never retried. A retry delay in Gemini's 429 body is not stated.

E-29: a signed-in localhost:11434 serves cloud models such as gpt-oss:120b-cloud; E-28 shows names like gemma4:cloud. At v0.34.4, responses and show/list carry remote_host and remote_model, and GET /api/status returns cloud.disabled (E-30). Cloud references are proxied, remote-host models get 403 while cloud is disabled, and /v1/chat/completions has the same passthrough (E-31). So locality must check /api/status or remote_host, not just the host. Not stated: how a reference is classified as cloud, and /api/status before v0.34.4.

Wire measurements that no page owns, each needing the vendor's own key: the exact body on each compatible endpoint, over-window bodies, CRLF/comment framing, Gemini native stream termination, fragmentation and usage, Mistral minted ids, and new probes (6)-(9). E-24: tools in OpenAI shape are transformed upstream, and parallel_tool_calls defaults to true. E-27: reasoning and reasoning_details can be sent back (reasoning_content is an alias), preserving them is needed during tool use, and the blocks must stay unmodified. Not stated: the streamed tool-call shape, how results go back, and which upstream models require reasoning_details. designFacts: The wire-state store becomes mandatory for tool use on four vendors. Anthropic thinking blocks must go back unmodified or the request gets a 400 (E-09, E-12, E-13), and thinking is always on for Fable 5.1, Mythos 5.1, Fable 5, Mythos 5 and Opus 5.5 (E-12). Gemini parts that carry thoughtSignature must be replayed (MISSING_THOUGHT_SIGNATURE, E-02; E-04). OpenAI reasoning items with encrypted_content should be replayed under store:false (E-18). DeepSeek needs reasoning_content back on every request with tools (E-19).

The existing openai-compatible kind breaks on DeepSeek's second tool request in its default thinking mode (400 without reasoning_content, E-19), unless the body sends a top-level thinking object disabled or reasoning_effort none (E-20). DeepSeek also documents only max_tokens, not max_completion_tokens (E-20).

Anthropic accepts Authorization: Bearer as the primary auth, with x-api-key as a legacy fallback (E-08). So the Bearer header at inference.ts:145 can stay for Anthropic, which adds only anthropic-version and content-type. Gemini native wants x-goog-api-key (E-06, E-01), and ?alt=sse is a fixed parameter main appends (E-02).

readSse and the accumulators must widen. OpenRouter sends ': OPENROUTER PROCESSING' comment lines and repeats finish_reason on its final usage chunk (E-25). Anthropic sends event:-named events, ping events and in-stream error events after a 200 (E-10, E-12). OpenRouter's mid-stream error chunk (finish_reason 'error', E-25) must become a failure, not an answer.

Over-window behaviour differs by vendor. Anthropic returns 400 invalid_request_error 'prompt is too long' for input alone; on Claude 4.5 and later, input plus max_tokens over the window is accepted and ends with stop_reason model_context_window_exceeded, which must map to incomplete (E-13, E-11). OpenAI Responses returns 400 under the default disabled truncation (E-16). Gemini is still unknown (U-05 pending).

Anthropic refusal is an HTTP 200 stop_reason with stop_details, not an error (E-11). OpenAI Responses can end incomplete with reason max_output_tokens before any visible output, because the cap covers reasoning (E-16, E-18). OpenRouter and DeepSeek caps also cover reasoning (E-24, E-27).

Anthropic's OpenAI layer documents Moonzila's whole body as accepted (max_completion_tokens, stream_options, tools fully supported). But it never returns thinking and its usage details are always empty (E-15), and thinking is on by default on Claude 5 models (E-15, E-12). Multi-turn tool use there is therefore unproven (probe U-18 (8)).

A signed-in loopback Ollama forwards cloud models such as gpt-oss:120b-cloud to ollama.com (E-29, E-28). At v0.34.4 a client can observe GET /api/status cloud.disabled and the remote_host on show, list and chat responses (E-30, E-31). Locality must check these, not only that the host is loopback.

Google's Gemini docs now default to the Interactions API, labelled 'Recommended' (E-01, E-03, E-04): POST v1beta/interactions, event:-named SSE ending in data: [DONE], and server-side state that handles signatures. generateContent remains documented (E-02). Which one to build is a Mandate decision; its reference https://ai.google.dev/api/interactions-api is linked from line 68 of the E-04 capture but is not needed by any current unknown.

OpenRouter needs no flag for usage. It always arrives on the last chunk, and stream_options is deprecated with no effect (E-26). Moonzila's current body is accepted (E-24), but tool turns wait for U-19, and reasoning_details must be preserved unmodified during tool use (E-27).
